visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a floppy sun hat and carrying a baby in a front carrier stands on a light-colored patio. Behind her is a turquoise pool and modern resort buildings with dark wood accents under a bright, cloudy sky. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor wooden spa area with black loungers partially submerged in a small pool. (3) A close-up shows a wooden sign for 'Spa Junglia' surrounded by lush green tropical plants and trees. (4) The woman with the baby stands next to a large outdoor infinity pool that overlooks a deep green valley and distant hills. (5) A series of quick cuts show different angles of the infinity pool, its wooden deck, and water spilling over the edge into the forest below. (6) Interior shots reveal a wooden sauna room with rows of benches and a clock, followed by a circular room with several individual shower stalls. (7) The woman is then seen standing under a rustic bucket-style outdoor shower, holding her baby close. (8) The camera follows her as she enters a dim, cave-like pool area with glowing blue water. (9) A person's hands are seen opening two wooden flip-top boxes containing amenity packets on a counter. (10) The woman, still with the baby, stands in a brightly lit dressing room holding a white handheld hair dryer. (11) A wide shot of a dining room with wooden tables and chairs leads into close-ups of gourmet dishes: raw tuna slices, a plated steak with vegetables, a custard dessert, and a colorful cocktail with an orange peel garnish. (12) A man in a blue shirt is visible behind a counter in the restaurant. (13) The final shot shows a large shuttle bus with 'Spa Junglia' branding driving away on a road lined with palm trees.
